faq.q: How much does a booking website cost in the UK?
faq.a: Booking apps cost from free to about £60 a month plus staff and card fees. A professionally built website with booking typically costs £749 to £3,000.

faq.q: Is Fresha free in the UK?
faq.a: Fresha now charges a monthly subscription for most businesses, plus a one-time commission on new clients it brings through its marketplace. Check its current UK pricing.
Take a deposit or card details at booking, send automatic reminders, and set a clear cancellation policy.

faq.q: Do I need my own website if I use a booking app?
faq.a: It helps. Your own site keeps repeat clients booking directly, builds your brand and gets found on Google and in AI answers.
Yes. Plumbers, electricians and cleaners often use a quote request form or booked call slots instead of fixed appointments.
